hook:
Logging dinner used to take me
longer than eating it. Three reasons:

beats.claim: I was searching for my own food
beats.reason: You already know what you ate; typing it into a search box only to hunt for it again is doing the work twice.

beats.claim: I was picking a portion size
beats.reason: A dropdown of cups and grams turns a description into an admin task, so there is no dropdown.
The ring on Today does the sum against a target, which is the one job a screen is actually good at.
